payload.meta_title: Mykonos Wedding Guide to Venues, Seasons and Paperwork
payload.meta_description: Plan a Mykonos wedding: choose an area and venue style, weigh the seasons, sort legal or symbolic paperwork and get your guests to the island with ease.

outline.h2: Why couples choose Mykonos for their wedding
outline.answers: mykonos wedding / wedding in mykonos (head term; NY AI overview opens on Aegean views, whitewashed architecture and hospitality)
outline.notes: Intro under 100 words, then exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways above this H2. Official tourism source only (visitgreece.gr). Link the Greece hub once.

outline.h2: Choosing where to marry on Mykonos
outline.answers: venue intent that dominates every SERP (Tripadvisor, venue lists, resort pages), handled briefly so the venues guide keeps 'mykonos wedding venues'
h3: Areas of the island and what each suits
Resorts with chapels, beach clubs, private villas and restaurants
Six venues to start your shortlist
outline.notes: 5 to 6 one-line examples re-checked on each venue's official site, no capacities unless sourced. Prominent link to /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues straight after the examples. No repeated venue entries. Link Greece venues guide once; Santorini and Paros as alternative islands.

outline.h2: When to get married in Mykonos
outline.answers: best time to get married in mykonos; season questions
h3: Weather by month at the Mykonos station
outline.notes: HNMS climatology labelled as the Mykonos station. Meltemi only as an official source states it. Smartraveller heat, wildfire, swimming, ferry wind and earthquake advice. No best month stated as fact.

outline.answers: legal wedding mykonos; getting married in mykonos; NY AI overview says planners 'handle legal paperwork'
h3: Civil marriage with the Municipality of Mykonos
outline.notes: Main section. Official sources only; date once 'as at November 2026'. Certificate of no impediment and notarial services at the Australian Embassy Athens; Smartraveller getting married overseas, recognition, legalisation and apostilles. Municipality steps only if an official page is read live, else 'check with the Municipality of Mykonos and the embassy, including any fees'. No statement on Greek apostille or translation needs or the same-sex civil marriage position without an official source. Nothing implying the Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork.

outline.answers: guest travel (Facebook threads in New York and Melbourne SERPs ask about visiting for a wedding)
h3: Transfers and access to ask about
outline.notes: Airport and port from official sources only. Transfers and step-free access framed as questions, no claims, no transfer arrangements.

outline.h2: House rules to agree before you book
outline.answers: booking questions couples raise in the SERP forum threads; 00-input house rules
outline.notes: Questions only: deposits, cancellation terms, exclusive use and for how many days, music cut-off times, set-up and pack-down, weather backup, outside suppliers. Items venues don't publish go on the booking checklist.

outline.h2: What shapes the cost of a Mykonos wedding
outline.answers: mykonos wedding cost / price / package price (related searches in all 5 cities; NY AI overview budget block)
outline.notes: One short paragraph, no figures or currencies: season, guest count, exclusive use, number of days, travel. Link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages.
FAQPage schema. One Advisor line in the body plus the close, claims only from brand-facts.md.

outline.answers: commercial next step (mykonos wedding planner intent served by the CTA)
outline.notes: Close with Wonderland Concierge (utm_content=closing). Never 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'. No Wedded Privileges.

Planned conflict: content/posts/mykonos-wedding-venues/02-seo.json lists 'mykonos wedding', 'wedding in mykonos' and 'getting married in mykonos' as its secondary keywords. With the head-term SERP this venue-heavy, Google could pick the venues guide for 'mykonos wedding' and split signals.

Split recommendation: this guide owns 'mykonos wedding', 'wedding in mykonos', 'getting married in mykonos', season, legal and elopement terms, and cost drivers (no figures). The venues guide owns 'mykonos wedding venues', villa, chapel and 'best venues' variants; remove the three head-term variants from its secondary list and keep its title and H1 led by 'Mykonos Wedding Venues'. 'mykonos wedding packages' and all-inclusive terms stay with /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages. 'mykonos wedding planner' is served by the Concierge CTA.

Linking: this guide links down to the venues guide prominently (anchor about venues); the venues guide links up with 'planning a Mykonos wedding'. Neither uses the other's primary keyword as an exact-match anchor more than once.

Link map: only the drafts /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues and /destination-weddings/paros-wedding-venues mention Mykonos; /destinations/europe/greece and /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues mention Mykonos briefly and should link down.
